objective: SHORT-DESC-20261112-001 direction 2 (G17, with G7), resumed by the owner on 2026-11-12 ('Let's start with that one'): nested NAE families that have no allowed state at some finite depth, with the holding knot at the bottom, while the bottomless pattern (every holding knot replaced forever) allows a state. Decide every family exactly, on all small one-definition families and on families drawn by the description code; measure how often the knot compares with its own image under one substitution, where a criterion by the largest self-consistent relation inside the knot is exact (proved) and where it fails; characterize the families alive only in the limit. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: compactness, Knaster-Tarski, Park's coinduction and iteration from seeds (Cousot and Cousot) are known; the census of NAE nested families and which ones live only in the limit was not found.
status: Complete 2026-11-12 (Partially successful; referee pending): nested NAE families that die at a finite depth while the bottomless pattern lives are 0.6% of families under the description code and 56% of finitely dying ones; each has a self-holding definition whose limit allows its ends all equal (proved), usually free; small families never die; the criterion inside the knot is exact where knot and image compare and fails in 13% of the rest.
